coverage_gaps: Nonselected cross-list version and first-announcement histories were not exhaustively checked; the 148 screened candidates are not a claim of 148 eligible new papers.
Linked executable code was not rerun. The complete external blazar machine-readable catalogue was not independently inspected; quoted values use the printed paper tables.
Historical comparisons read the relevant primary methods/results/discussion, not every cited paper in full. The independent Nature HTML fallback succeeded after search/browser retrieval failures.

second_topic_pass.method: Independent pass through deduplicated titles and abstracts using particle acceleration/propagation, cosmic rays, neutrino interactions/oscillations, electromagnetic cascades, multimessenger, dark matter and cosmology topics; explicit re-evaluation of salient candidates before final ranking.
